visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit BIC CAMERA store aisle, filled with colorful stationery displays. The camera pans across shelves of pens and markers. A woman in a black puffer jacket and pink mask is seen briefly holding items, setting the shopping context in a dense retail environment with multiple price tags and promotional signs visible. (2) Close-up of ZEBRA Lightwrite pens in various colors. A hand interacts with a green pen, clicking the top to activate a bright LED at the writing tip. The hand writes on a small white notepad while the camera focuses on the light illuminating the paper surface against a background of packaging featuring police and camping illustrations. (3) Transition to a display of ZEBRA bLen pens in pastel shades. A hand demonstrates writing on a vertical notepad attached to the store shelf. The camera highlights the smooth ink flow and ergonomic grip, showing how the pen performs even when used against a vertical surface in a standing position within the busy store environment. (4) Presentation of PLUS fitcut long-handled scissors. The woman holds the large yellow and white packaging to emphasize its scale compared to her torso. The camera then zooms in on the 220mm long blades, which are marketed as being able to cut A4 paper in a single stroke, shown against a background of other household tools. (5) Detailed view of KOKUYO HAKO-AKE 2-way cutters. The camera focuses on the beige and olive green tools, then flips the packaging to show diagrams explaining the dual functionality of a cutter and scissors. The background remains the busy, brightly lit store shelf with various white and red price labels. (6) Demonstration of the TOMBOW MONO work 1.3mm mechanical pencil. A hand holds the thick grey pencil and rapidly shades in bubbles on a standardized test sheet. The camera captures the speed and coverage of the thick lead, emphasizing time-saving benefits for examinees in a high-contrast close-up shot. (7) Close-up of the KOKUYO 1-line eraser, featuring a unique star-shaped cross-section. A hand holds the white eraser and precisely removes a single line of handwritten text from a notepad, showing how the thin edge avoids smudging adjacent lines. The packaging displays a clean blue and white design on the shelf. (8) Introduction of the Pentel CLIC ERASER designed specifically for oil-based ballpoint ink. The hand uses the pen-style eraser on a piece of paper. The camera stays tight on the action, while text overlays provide a personal review of the product's effectiveness, showing the texture of the eraser and paper. (9) The final segment shows TOMBOW MONO natural erasers. A hand reaches into a wooden display box filled with small, beige-colored erasers. The camera captures the texture of the eco-friendly shell-based material before transitioning to a final graphic screen featuring a large QR code and social media icons for the Japanuts brand.

The acoustic guitar continues its repetitive, melodic plucking, maintaining a stable harmonic tension level and a moderate conversational-style amplitude intensity despite the complete lack of speech. The music's beat strength is moderate, providing a consistent pace that matches the rapid visual cuts and editing style of the product showcase. The BGM remains the dominant acoustic layer, with no shifts in pitch or tempo. The overall Signal-To-Noise ratio is high, as the 'noise' is limited to these intentional incidental product sounds captured clearly. (6) The upbeat acoustic track continues through the final product shots, maintaining its bright and energetic vibe. As the video concludes with the QR code and social media information screen, the music undergoes a smooth, linear fade-out into studio silence, completing the linear and continuous audio sequence without any voice-over.
